submission.justification: Provisional recommendation only. Crystal-K2 at 5 cm has the best simulated 662 keV resolution (2.89% FWHM, 100k events). It is the best of the 9 simulated crystal-thickness combinations at every thickness. However, the hard constraint is not cleared. No project document or simulation output gives intrinsic background (100-3000 keV), K-40, U/Th or Lu-176 activity, or density for K1, K2 or K3, so the 0.5 counts/kg/day limit is unverified for every candidate. Thicker crystals likely add background counts, which is unquantified. This selection should not be procured or adopted until a vendor radiopurity certificate or measured background shows K2 at 5 cm meets the 0.5 counts/kg/day limit over 100-3000 keV. If K2 fails, the next step is K1 at 5 cm (4.71% FWHM), then re-screen.
